title: Why does the crack keep coming back?
description: Choose what a repair handoff carries about a small footbridge, then inspect the example repair it produces and the checks run on it.
initialCaption: The handoff names only the symptom: “stop the deck cracking over pier 2”. Look around, choose what the handoff carries, then repair from it.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom · tap the pier split or the boat to add or remove it from the handoff
fallback: The deck crack over pier 2 keeps returning because the pier is split on its upstream face, under the deck, and boats need the lane beside it kept clear. In these authored examples a deck patch fails under load, a prop that knows about the split blocks the boat, and an underpin inside the pier's footprint passes both checks, which cover only load and clearance.
